title: Render Int negations and negative quotients as differences in Lean
summary: The Lean reconstructor now writes every Int negation as the difference 0 - t and a div by a negative constant as 0 - t / (0 - d), with a kernel-checked theorem equating it to t / d. This removes the remaining kernel rejections over the numeral -0, such as for (f (div 2 (- 5))), without adding an axiom or moving the trust boundary.
